name: io.github.antohins/seo-tools-mcp-xmlriver
title: SEO Tools: XMLRiver SERP (Google + Yandex)
description: Google & Yandex SERP, image/news verticals and URL indexation checks via XMLRiver (read-only).

environmentVariables.name: XMLRIVER_USER
environmentVariables.description: XMLRiver user ID (from the xmlriver.com dashboard).

environmentVariables.name: XMLRIVER_EXCLUDE_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Aggregator domains excluded by excludeAggregators, comma-separated.

environmentVariables.name: XMLRIVER_PRICE_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Price per SERP call in RUB for cost logging (default 0.02).
